events.verdict: Lyles (SAC) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
DeRozan (SAC) legally contests Lopez's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Lopez's (MIL) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim prior to the expiration of the 24 second shot clock.
Kuzma (MIL) is moving alongside DeRozan's (SAC) path when both players come together at the same spot during the drive.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) legally contests Murray's (SAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Murray (SAC) comes together with Antetokoumpo (MIL) as the contact that occurs off-ball is marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) briefly grasps Murray's (SAC) jersey during the inbound.
Lyles (SAC) turns slightly towards Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and the contact that occurs prior to Murray (SAC) blocking the shot attempt is marginal.
Murray (SAC) cleanly blocks Antetokounmpo's (MIL) driving shot attempt.
Lyles (SAC) is already in Kuzma's (MIL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
DeRozan (SAC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Lopez (MIL) at the end of the drive.  Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.
Lyles (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bucks.
Lopez (MIL) briefly grasps Lyles' (SAC) arm as both player pursue the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Murray (SAC) does not establish himself in Porter Jr.'s (MIL) path and continues to move forward into his space, delivering contact as the pick is set.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) cleanly blocks LaVine's (SAC) driving shot attempt. Any ensuing arm contact that occurs after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.
Lyles (SAC) swipes his hand forward and initiates contact with Kuzma's (MIL) arm.
Murray (SAC) commits a take foul on Antetokoumpo (MIL).
Antetokoumpo (MIL) releases the free throw attempt within 10 seconds.
Lopez (MIL) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
